title: ShankTaperDefinition
description: A real, already-shipped Sprint 17 structure: mirrors backend/jewelmind/domain/schema.py::BandTaperSpec exactly (also exposed in JDL as band.widthTaper / band.thicknessTaper). mode=NONE means no taper (default); mode=TOWARD_BOTTOM anchors the full base dimension at the head (u=0) and linearly interpolates to bottomRatio*base at the bottom (u=0.5), symmetric in both directions from the head. See docs/bible/19-shank/548-taper-model.md.

mode.description: TOWARD_HEAD, symmetric two-point tapers, and non-linear taper curves are PLANNED, not implemented in v1 — see docs/bible/appendices/shank-capability-catalog.md.

bottomRatio.description: Multiplier applied to the base dimension at the bottom (u=0.5) when mode=TOWARD_BOTTOM. Ignored when mode=NONE. Always in (0, 1] — a ratio above 1 (widening toward the bottom) is not supported in v1.
